title: About Me
text:
My background is in evolutionary biology, where I used computational approaches to analyze large-scale biological datasets. Through my research, I developed expertise in programming, statistical analysis, workflow automation, and scientific computing. I am interested in applying these skills to data-driven challenges in biotechnology, healthcare, and technology.
